# First Mate

## Overview

- **Age:** at least nine years old  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P42](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0042)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Moses  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P42](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0042)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

The First Mate is a magnificent, massive, orange-hued cat with a face as round as a full moon, striking green eyes, and huge, double white paws. So big and radiant that he can resemble a warm, velvety sphere of gold, he often sleeps rolled up in a large golden ball.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P25](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0025), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P37](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0037), [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P2](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P7](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT SEVEN GULLS P39](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0039)_

## Personality

The First Mate is friendly by nature, making him a welcoming companion to those around him. However, he is not given to much conversation and generally speaks very little.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P54](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0054)_

## Traits

- does not converse very much  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P54](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0054)</sub>
- friendly  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P54](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0054)</sub>

## History

Nine years prior, First Mate was rescued from a freezing winter day by Captain Saul after becoming trapped in tree branches by a ribbon collar and nearly starving. Years later, as Captain Saul contemplated his own mortality, he asked [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to care for the cat, whom he also called Matey, after his death.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P38](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0038), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P42](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0042), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P46](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0046), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P49](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0049), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P57](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0057), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT SEVEN GULLS P6](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0006), +3 more_
